record.title: OCEL v2 RevOps
record.body: R78 keeps RevenueFROMCustomer and RevenueFORCustomer as distinct capital-score dimensions after hard admissibility. No realized revenue is inferred this run. Downstream demand is explicitly bound before selection; future economic evidence must bind Problem, consumer/ICP, value metric, proof, offer, distribution, payer, beneficiary, ValueOutcome, CustomerRevenueOutcome, retention/expansion and attribution to qualified exact subjects.
